expert_title: Senior Manager, TOUR & Golfbet Editorial & Distribution
comment: The Swede is a clear favorite this week, with six of his last seven starts going for T8 or better.

His three excellent rounds, including a Sunday 65 on a difficult Aronimink setup at the PGA Championship, should have him ready for the test at Colonial Country Club. There are not many better with a wedge in hand.
I have to go with the guy who has been incredibly consistent the last two months. Plus, I'm out of starts for Åberg.
Riding the hot hand and there’s nobody better than Smalley. He’s gone T2-T17-T7-T2-T14 in his last five starts. Ready to make up ground.
After his first major championship contention in a good while, I am ready to believe again. Can ride his hot putter and shape his way around a classic Colonial layout that suits him.
